description.value: A BC Green-certified eco glamping retreat near Beasley (Nelson area) offering furnished tents with hot outdoor shower and flush toilets; no BYO tents or pets allowed, sites are walk-in only up a short steep trail from the parking lot, and the season opens mid-May.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is complete and detailed. Bear Spring Eco Retreat is a glamping-only site — the FAQ explicitly states guests cannot bring their own tents or trailers, campsites are walk-in only up a steep trail from the parking area, and all accommodations are pre-furnished. Showers are confirmed in the FAQ ('hot outdoor shower with solar heated tank and on-demand propane heater'). Reservations are confirmed by prominent 'Book Now' CTAs. The site has active bear presence (guard dog Bella explicitly mentioned to deter bears), but no animal-safe food storage is mentioned anywhere on the site.
concerns: Campsites are walk-in only from parking lot via a short steep trail — cyclists with loaded bikes may find luggage portage inconvenient.
Personal tents and trailers are explicitly not permitted; guests must use provided glamping accommodations only.
Active bear presence noted on property (guard dog Bella deployed to deter bears), but no animal-safe food storage option mentioned.
No phone number available in OSM record or on website; contact is email-only (info@bearspringeco.ca).
Street address not explicitly confirmed on website — OSM address used.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Legitimate BC-based glamping campsite with confirmed reservations, shower facilities, and strong eco-credentials; a touring cyclist seeking a comfortable overnight stop in the West Kootenays would benefit from this listing, though the walk-in-only access and glamping-only format are notable constraints.

wow_evidence: walk-in only up a short steep trail from the parking lot… BC Green-certified eco glamping… guests cannot bring their own tents
